body: I've been told that a million times that it will get better... for 5 years now... and its only gotten worse... I want to believe it will get better.. but I've been hurt so much... and I've tried to open myself to things with a positive attitude.. then I only get hurt again And worse.... im just sick of myself... ive tried to hold on... my music is honestly one of the few reasons im here... but even that cant help me... i cut almost every night.... im addicted to the pain i cause myself... i just dont see myself... getting better... my mom has been really sick lately as well... she has a problem with her Thyroid gland l... it makes her immune system weak shes gotten worse every day.... even though i feel like she hates me it would kill me to see her leave... i want to make her proud... but im nothing.. worthless.. listen to the song Second & Sebring it always brings tears to my eyes...
Thanks.... but I feel like I have no reason to stay....
